snippet.title: paris jackson - teenage drama (acapella)
snippet.description:
lyrics:

here come all the teenage drama
breaking bones to reach nirvana
fighting through the zombie nation
fighting through a desperation

you’re in your head
i’m right here
i’m right here

here come all the wasted grown ups
like suits and ties could be personas
wanna be their own creations
but all they want is dreams and ratings
here come all the wasted grown ups

you’re in your head
i’m right here, yeah
come right here, yeah
we’re right here, yeah
i’m right here

here come all the well trained robots
stealing all the could be free thoughts
so messed up how we got left off
replace the art with cash and roadblocks

it’s in your head, bring it here, yeah
come right here, yeah
we’re right here, yeah
i’m right here
i’m right here
